seo.title: Hiring & Staffing Services
seo.description: Executive search, mid-senior and bulk hiring, flexible staffing, US staffing, RPO, interim management and background verification — one accountable partner.

hero.title: Every way you hire,
hero.lead: From a confidential CXO search to staffing a new site, pick the model that fits the role — or tell us the brief and we'll recommend one.

heading.title: Built around
heading.lead: Permanent, contract or fully outsourced — each service is run by a specialist team with one point of contact.

executive-search.text: Confidential, research-led search for CXO and leadership roles — mapped to your strategy, not just a job description.

rpo.text: We become your talent-acquisition team — sourcing to onboarding, under your brand.

heading.title: Four models,
heading.lead: Timelines and pricing below are typical ranges to help you shortlist — every engagement is scoped to your brief.

items.title: One critical leadership hire
items.text: CXO, VP and functional heads — confidential replacements, new market entries and transformation mandates.

items.title: 6–12 weeks
items.text: From brief to accepted offer, with a shortlist of 3–5 assessed candidates along the way.

items.title: Retained fee
items.text: Typically a percentage of first-year CTC, staged across search milestones.

items.title: Ongoing, multi-role hiring
items.text: Companies that need a predictable pipeline across functions without growing an in-house TA team.

items.title: Live in 2–4 weeks
items.text: Discovery, process design and recruiter onboarding, then continuous delivery against SLAs.

items.title: Monthly + per hire
items.text: A management fee for the embedded team, plus a success fee per hire — or per-project pricing.

items.title: Many similar roles, fast
items.text: New sites, plant expansions, project ramp-ups and seasonal peaks.

items.title: 2–6 weeks per drive
items.text: Depends on volume, locations and assessment steps agreed at kick-off.

items.title: Per hire, tiered
items.text: A fixed fee per joiner, with volume tiers for larger drives.

items.title: Flexible capacity
items.text: Projects, backfills and skills you need now — without adding permanent headcount.

items.title: Days to 2 weeks
items.text: Deploy from our pre-screened network; scale up or down as the work changes.

items.title: Monthly bill rate
items.text: One invoice covering salary, statutory costs, compliance and our service fee.

heading.title: Why teams choose
heading.lead: Our flexible staffing model gives you ready talent on demand — with the employer responsibilities handled by us.

items.question: Which service should I start with?
items.answer: Tell us the roles, volumes and timelines. We'll recommend a model — often a mix, such as executive search for the leader and bulk hiring for the team.

items.question: Can you hire outside your office cities?
items.answer: Yes. We serve clients across India and internationally through our UAE and US entities, from offices in Nagpur, Hyderabad, Dubai and Dallas.

items.question: Are searches confidential?
items.answer: Yes. All searches and search criteria are kept confidential, and client identity is shared only at the stage you approve.

items.question: Do you also help candidates?
items.answer: Yes — candidates can browse open roles or submit a CV to join our network.

cta.title: Tell us the role.
cta.text: Share your brief and a specialist will respond within one business day with a recommended model and plan.
